title: What's new in the Fizzl Agent Wallet: no keys to copy, limits on the chain, no paying twice

card.title: Your agent's wallet.
card.sub: Now without copying a single key.
card.note: What's new in the Fizzl Agent Wallet

segments.text: Giving an AI agent its own wallet used to mean copying keys into a config file. Not anymore.
Download the wallet for Claude Desktop and open the file. That's the whole install: no keys, no config file, no Node.js. On Claude Code or Cursor, it's one line.
Ask your agent for its wallet status. It makes its own wallet on your computer, and answers with a link and a short code. The key never leaves your machine.
Open the link, and the code is already filled in. Give your agent a name, click link, and it's ready to pay. Within your rules, from the very first payment.
Want the limit on the blockchain itself? Your USDC stays in your own wallet. A small contract on Base tops your agent up, at most two dollars a day. Even a leaked key can't take more.
And it won't pay twice. If a seller takes the money without answering, or asks again with a new address, the wallet checks on-chain what happened, and holds back a second payment.
